steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90; this is the required starting screen for the prepared two-bid state.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before using the prepared RFQ.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round in Vendor A's event list.
Revise and resubmit Vendor A's existing bid at the same price of 100.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the revised RFQ bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's session to inspect the resulting bid data.
Open the buyer's Responses view for the RFQ.
Confirm both vendor responses remain visible to the buyer after Vendor A's resubmission.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid.
Confirm the comparison still contains the two real bidding vendors.
Verify Vendor A's displayed unit price remains 100 after the same-price revision.
